VI.description: Before the server loop starts\3A RemoteVI Server Setup.vi prepares the page\2C the greeting\2C the geometry and the target (a VI's panel\2C or a window - over VI Server when its LabVIEW runs one\2C else Win32 only). Returns the context (what does not change while the share runs\2C with the share's entry for the status\3A kind VI for a VI's panel\2C VI Server for a window of another LabVIEW reached over VI Server\2C Window for a window shared through Win32 only\2C and when the share started) and the initial loop state.
